newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's President Emil Constantinescu will attend the world economic summit in Davos. The Romanian delegation plans to contact powerful financial groups to outline economic opportunities in Romania.
Constantinescu will plead for Romania's integration into NATO structures during his visits to Belgium and France.
* U.S. State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns told a news conference the U.S. was impressed with developments in Romania's political and economic life.
Burns said the U.S. would not exclude any country which is a member of the Partnership for Peace from NATO'S enlargement process, but it would not favour anyone.
* Parliament's lower house will resume work on Monday.
* Gennady Seleznyov, chairman of Russia's lower house of parliament, said after his meeting with Senate chairman Petre Roman that Russia considered the NATO a military bloc.
Petre Roman said the NATO was a political and military reality and Romania was interested in the political component of the Atlantic Alliance.
